title: Painting of Mia
wikitext:
[[File:Painting of Mia.png|thumb|Painting of Mia]]

The '''Painting of Mia''' is a depiction of [[Mia Greymane]], the late wife of King [[Genn Greymane]] of [[Gilneas (kingdom)|Gilneas]] located inside the [[Gilneas City library]]. It is a portrait of her as a young child. [[Luke Agamand]] asks Horde adventurers to steal it in order to fence it for a profit.<ref>{{questlong|Horde|45D|A Royal Heist}}</ref>

==Objective of==
Contains [[Portrait of Mia Greymane]] for the quest {{questlong|Horde|45D|A Royal Heist}}.
